paragraphs: Rav Chinena bar Avin, student of Rava. This requires investigation, for Rava told R. Chinena bar Avin's son, “I will tell you an excellent thing in your father's name”: Ketubot 85b. Ammi bar Avin and Chananyah bar Avin both said: Keritot 20a, near the end. R. Chanina bar Avin and Abaye bar Avin: chapter Rabbi Akiva, Shabbat 86b; Megillah 7b [the source's side mark is defective]; Bava Batra 87b. Pesachim 34a: they were studying Terumot in Rabbah’s school when Rava bar Mattana met them. Abaye sat with them: beginning of Kol Gaggot, Eruvin 89a.
